eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Blaine, ID; at 5:25 PM on AUG 26, 2026 Effective until 4:25 PM AUG 27, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
EVACUATION ALERT: The Blaine County Sheriff has placed residents in the South Carey zone from Preacher Bridge on the East side of HWY 26 to Red Hawk Lane on Level 3 GO NOW EVACUATION STATUS due to the danger from the Wildhorse Fire in Lincoln County, Idaho. Leave immediately. It is not safe in your area.

You will not be let back in until after the fire danger has passed and the evacuation status has been lifted. Stay alert for more fire updates.
